title: Requirement guarded by an interpreter marker
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker.
limitation: It matches a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
